frequency_question: How often do major energy permitting reform bills pass Congress under similar legislative friction conditions?
membership_rule: Includes major comprehensive energy, transmission, or permitting reform acts or titles of major packages that sought to overhaul NEPA or pipeline approvals. Excludes pure appropriations bills or narrow single-agency technical corrections.

cases.name: Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007
Debt Limit Deal Permitting Provisions / Fiscal Responsibility Act

coverage_note: 4 named major legislative push cycles; captures all primary comprehensive attempts.
known_gaps: Does not fully account for hyper-polarized current floor dynamics compared to 2005 or 2007.
skeleton: 4 major legislative push cycles for comprehensive energy/permitting reform since 2005, yielding 3 hits (including partial/rider vehicles) and 1 outright miss.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 4 major structured attempts
validity_reason: Based on institutional rules of the Senate (like the filibuster) and House committee structures which persist across multiple Congresses.
